arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.description: One computer, every free game: pick a game on the wall and play a friend or the computer, with ratings and leaderboards.

baccarat.name: Baccarat
baccarat.description: Eight-deck baccarat with Player, Banker and Tie bets.

big-table.name: Big Table
big-table.description: Eight casino games for up to eight players, each at their own screen. Install it on every computer: a 6x6 wall becomes the dealer and a smaller one a seat.

blackjack.name: Blackjack
blackjack.description: Six-deck blackjack with a lasting shoe, doubles on 11 and one split.

blightmare.name: BLIGHTMARE
blightmare.description: A dark first-person RPG for one wall: a continent, a plague, and a hero who has never dreamed.

block_reader_vhcctweaks_probe.name: Block Reader vhcctweaks Probe
block_reader_vhcctweaks_probe.description: Probes an Advanced Peripherals Block Reader and reports whether vhcctweaks is blocking it.

casino.name: Casino
casino.description: Every single-player casino game on one cabinet: pick a game from the menu, and it plays just as its own table does.

casino-hub.name: Casino Hub
casino-hub.description: The casino's central board: shared jackpot, leaderboards, each game's measured return, and the tables on the floor.

classics.name: Classics
classics.description: Pac-Man, Asteroids, Space Invaders and more early arcade games, played by touch for the high score.

classics2.name: Classics 2
classics2.description: Dig Dug, Flappy Bird, Minesweeper, Tapper, Mappy and more, played by touch for the high score.

conformance_probe.name: Conformance Probe
conformance_probe.description: Conformance probe: run it on a real computer, then give conformance_results.json to the emulator project

crazyeights.name: CrazyEights
crazyeights.description: Fast single-hand Crazy Eights duel with wild 8s and draw 2s.

duel.name: Duel
duel.description: One on one for tokens on two equal 6x6 walls back to back: Heads-Up Hold'em, Gin Rummy, Liar's Dice and Battleship.

hilo.name: Hi-Lo
hilo.description: Higher or lower through one deck, with every guess priced from the cards left.

horse-racing.name: Horse Racing
horse-racing.description: Six horses, fresh odds each race, with win, place, show and exacta bets.

longgames.name: Long Games
longgames.description: Oregon Trail, Tower of Druaga and a first-person dungeon crawl, with your progress saved between visits.

phone_os.name: Pocket Casino OS
phone_os.description: Pocket casino shell for ComputerCraft pocket computers.

pokertable.name: PokerTable
pokertable.description: Five-card draw for 2 to 6 players on one wall, player against player, with side pots and no rake.

roulette.name: Roulette
roulette.description: Single-zero European roulette with inside and outside bets.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: Three-reel slot machine with weighted symbols and pair payouts.

sound_browser.name: Sound Browser
sound_browser.description: Browse the pack's generated sound catalog and save favorites.

storage_check.name: Storage Check
storage_check.description: Shows how much disk space this computer has, its drives, and its private vhcc folder. It only reads: nothing is written.

taskmaster.name: TaskMaster
taskmaster.description: A stateless, anonymous item exchange kiosk for ComputerCraft

three-card-poker.name: 3 Card Poker
three-card-poker.description: Ante and Play against the dealer, with an Ante Bonus and a Pair Plus side bet.

ultimate-holdem.name: Ultimate Texas Hold'em
ultimate-holdem.description: Ante and Blind against the dealer, with one raise from 4x down to 1x and a Trips side bet.

ultimate-tic-tac-toe.name: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
ultimate-tic-tac-toe.description: Nine boards in one: two players (or the computer) fight for three small boards in a row, with ratings, leaderboards and sound.

vault_item_analyzer.name: vault_item_analyzer
vault_item_analyzer.description: Vault Item Analyzer: Scans all peripheral inventories and displays vault item data on a monitor

vaultgear.name: VaultGear
vaultgear.description: Vault Storage Manager startup entry point.

versus.name: Versus
versus.description: MOAG, Pong, Bomberman and Tron light cycles: two players, one wall each, in real time.

vhcctweaks_smoke_test.name: VH CC Tweaks Smoke Test
vhcctweaks_smoke_test.description: Guided proof-check for ccvault, vhcc, auth, and vault item detail enrichment.

videopoker.name: VideoPoker
videopoker.description: Jacks or Better draw poker with payout and tutorial screens.
